hero.desc: MERMAD Mining extracts Turkey's rich mineral resources through the safest, most sustainable methods — creating value for the national economy and global markets.

about.p1: MERMAD Mining is an experienced mining company conducting exploration, extraction, and processing operations across various regions of Turkey. We harness Anatolia's rich mineral potential with modern technology and a team of experts.
about.p2: Since our founding, we have operated with a commitment to safe working environments, environmental awareness, and contributing to local employment.
about.pillar1Desc: Occupational health and safety is our top priority. We work toward a zero-accident target.
about.pillar2Desc: We protect nature in everything we do, restoring sites through rehabilitation programs.
about.pillar3Desc: We fully comply with international mining standards and Turkish regulations.

services.title: End-to-End Mining Services
services.s1Desc: We identify mineral potential through geological surveys, seismic research, and drilling programs.
services.s2Desc: We carry out safe and efficient extraction using both open-pit and underground methods.
services.s3Desc: We convert raw material into high-value products through crushing, grinding, flotation, and beneficiation.
services.s4Desc: We protect nature through environmental impact assessment, waste management, and site rehabilitation.
services.s5Desc: We provide comprehensive consultancy in mining engineering, feasibility, and project management.
services.s6Desc: We target zero accidents through risk assessment, safety training, and emergency response planning.

cta.desc: Meet with our experienced team for your mining projects. We are happy to develop tailored solutions to meet your needs.

footer.desc: We bring Turkey's underground riches to the surface. Safe, sustainable, and responsible mining.

footer.slogan: Produced in Turkey, delivered to the world.

about_page.missionDesc: To contribute to Turkey's development by processing underground resources with modern technology, experienced human capital, and a sense of responsibility.
about_page.visionDesc: To become Turkey's most trusted mining company through our sustainability, innovation, and safety standards.

timeline.event: MERMAD Mining was founded and initial geological surveys commenced.
First mining license obtained in Central Anatolia; production began.
Ore processing plant commissioned; capacity tripled.
ISO 14001 Environmental and ISO 45001 Occupational Safety certifications obtained.
5 new sites opened; personnel count exceeded 100.
International export agreements signed; annual capacity reached 500K tons.

activities_page.desc: We manage all mining processes in an integrated manner — from exploration and extraction to environmental management and occupational safety.

activities.title: Mineral Exploration & Survey
activities.desc: We identify mineral potential through in-depth analysis of Turkey's geological structure.

activities.title: Open Pit Mining
activities.desc: We efficiently extract near-surface mineral deposits using open-pit methods with advanced equipment.

activities.title: Ore Processing
activities.desc: We process extracted raw ore in our beneficiation plants to produce high market-value products.

activities.title: Environmental Management
activities.desc: Our ISO 14001-certified environmental management system minimizes the environmental impact of our operations.

activities.title: Technical Consultancy
activities.desc: We provide comprehensive technical consultancy for mining projects with our experienced engineering team.

activities.title: Occupational Health & Safety
activities.desc: We target zero accidents with safety practices compliant with ISO 45001 standards.

projects_page.desc: From the Aegean to the Black Sea, from Central Anatolia to the Southeast, we unlock Turkey's mineral wealth across our sites.

projects.name: Central Anatolia Chromite Site
projects.desc: One of the region's largest chromite operations, this project in the rich chrome deposits of Central Anatolia operates at an annual production capacity of 80,000 tons.

projects.name: Aegean Boron Project
projects.desc: Operating in Turkey's boron deposits — which account for 70% of global reserves — our project exports high-purity boron products.

projects.name: Black Sea Copper Exploration
projects.desc: Comprehensive geological surveys and drilling programs are ongoing in the metallogenically rich formations of the Black Sea region.

projects.name: Southeast Phosphate Site
projects.desc: Infrastructure construction and equipment installation continue for this phosphate project, which will supply fertilizer raw materials to the agricultural sector.

projects.name: Eastern Anatolia Iron Project
projects.desc: This site, operated between 2014 and 2021, produced a total of 1.2 million tons of iron ore for the steel industry. Site rehabilitation has been completed.

projects.name: Aegean Trona Mine
projects.desc: Trona mineral — a key raw material for the glass and chemical industries — is extracted from underground galleries and refined in our processing plant.
